focusAfterSkip.name: TRANSPARENT RULESClear rules from your first depositThe final deposit transfers all agreed assets in one transaction. If a participant is missing, recover your own deposit after the deadline.Shared settlementEach participant gives one exact asset amount and receives the previous participant's asset. The final valid deposit executes all transfers atomically. An error reverts that entire final transaction; earlier deposits remain.A lock with a deadlineA deposit cannot be revoked early and the deadline cannot be extended. The final participant may wait for a price change. After the deadline, each funded deposit can be refunded separately, without operator or counterparty approval.The recipient is fixedThe program checks the actual token-account owner, mint, delegate and frozen state. A refund to a new account preserves the deposit owner. The board operator has no keys to your tokens.Separate costsThe protocol charges no commission. The network charges fees, including for some failed transactions. The creator supplies SOL for account storage. Closing an empty vault returns its SOL to the original payer. The cycle record remains, so its storage cost is not returned. focusAfterSkip.name: TRANSPARENT RULESClear rules from your first depositThe final deposit transfers all agreed assets in one transaction. If a participant is missing, recover your own deposit after the deadline.Shared settlementEach participant gives one exact asset amount and receives the previous participant's asset. The final valid deposit executes all transfers atomically.
